testing.command: make setup && python3 -m pytest (run in a disposable copy at /tmp/deskly-test)

side_effects.detail: Copied the repo to /tmp/deskly-test to run make setup + pytest there; the copy was deleted afterwards.

Did NOT run make setup in /work/repo: scripts/reset_fixtures.py runs DELETE FROM users on the tracked data/dev.db (1204 rows), replacing them with 8 fixtures, and migrate.py changes it too. Running tests in the real repo needs that destructive setup.
Only in the disposable copy: reset_fixtures dropped 1204 users from the copied dev.db. The real data/dev.db is untouched.

summary: find_by_email now compares lower(email) = lower(?), which also finds rows stored in mixed case. create raises ValueError when the email already exists, ignoring case. tickets.add strips the subject and raises ValueError if it is blank. tickets.close raises KeyError when no row was updated. The tests already in the repo cover all of these, and all 33 passed.
